name: AI Meeting Scheduler - Freelancer Gmail Confirmation

parameters.subject: ={{ $json.client_email_message.subject }}
parameters.options: ={{ { appendAttribution: false, senderName: $json.client_email_message.sender_name, ...($json.config.attach_ics ? { attachmentsUi: { attachmentsBinary: [{ property: $json.client_email_message.attachment_binary_property }] } } : {}) } }}

parameters.jsCode:
return [{ json: {
  success: false,
  meeting_created: $json.request?.meeting_created ?? true,
  calendar_event_created: $json.request?.calendar_event_created ?? true,
  host_email_sent: false,
  host_email_skipped: true,
  client_email_sent: false,
  email_sender: 'authenticated freelancer Gmail account',
  email_recipient: $json.request?.client_email ?? null,
  zoom_join_url: $json.request?.zoom_join_url ?? null,
  meeting_id: $json.request?.zoom_meeting_id ?? null,
  message: 'The client confirmation was not sent because the email payload is invalid.',
  validation_errors: $json.errors
} }];
